function.name: sketchfab_api_call
function.description:
Call the Sketchfab Data API v3 (rooted at https://api.sketchfab.com/v3). An API key may be configured (optional) — do NOT use requests.

RETURN VALUE: a JSON string; json.loads it -> {"status_code", "data", "error", "blast_radius"}.

KEY ENDPOINTS (all GET, all low):
  GET /search?type=models&q=<query>&downloadable=true   Search models; data.results = [{uid,name,user}] (NO license slug in search results)
  GET /models/{uid}                    Model detail incl. REAL license at data.license.slug (low)
  GET /models/{uid}/download           Time-limited download URLs (REQUIRES a key) (low)
  GET /me                              Current account (validates the key) (low)
  GET /licenses                        License catalog (low)

DO NOT add license=cc0 to search: that filter is extremely sparse and returns ZERO for most specific queries (e.g. "network router"). Instead search WITHOUT a license filter, then GET /models/{uid} for each candidate to read data.license.slug, and only recommend/download models whose license is CC0 ("cc0") or otherwise clearly reusable.

BLAST RADIUS: everything is low (read-only). On 401 the key is invalid; without a key, downloads fail but search still works (rate-limited).
